The robotic head tilts and the jaw opens mechanically. A wooden wall with "Henn na Hotel" branding is visible in the background under warm spotlights. (2) The scene cuts to the reception desk where two dinosaur robots act as staff members, positioned behind monitors and payment terminals. The desk is clean, modern, and made of light-colored wood. A red and gold banner hangs on the left side of the frame, adding a traditional Japanese touch to the futuristic setting. (3) The camera pans across a brightly lit hotel room containing two twin beds with white linens and grey runners. A dark wooden desk holds a television and a laptop, with a simple chair tucked underneath. An air purifier stands on the floor next to a beige curtain, creating a clean and functional atmosphere. (4) A sequence shows the bathroom's interior, highlighting a separate toilet with a bidet and a white bathtub with chrome fixtures. The walls are finished in a warm wood texture. A hand briefly enters the frame to display packaged toothbrushes, demonstrating the amenities provided by the hotel for guests.
